scope: Current error-producer surface and catalogue coverage for Skill inspection, proposal admission and description authoring.

surfaces.skills/inspection/utils.py: InspectionError's code reaches integrations/langflow/viewer.py read_skill detail.code unchanged (400 invalid identity, otherwise404). History/comparison routes collapse inspection exceptions to their own existing categories.
surfaces.frontend/langflow-skill-viewer/SkillFile: Current, historical and comparison reads use the shared catalogue and inline presenter. Immutable, unsafe and oversized refusals offer no Reload; unknown failures offer read-only Reload. Safe details use the shared copy icon.
surfaces.skills/authoring/summary.py: The service prepare path can raise skill_summary_source_unavailable. Operations HTTP catches it and returns skill_operation_refused; source paths/snapshot bytes are not exposed.
surfaces.skills/operations/utils.py: Proposal delegates to canonical SkillProposal/FileEdit admission. Operations HTTP still collapses model failures to skill_operation_refused. The graph's direct proposal admission can expose skill_operation_invalid, now covered by the shared catalogue.

acceptance: Catalogue and producer controls are internal regression evidence. Real browser error, recovery and copy behavior and owner acceptance remain pending.
